svg.title: 1. Multi-account landing zone
svg.text: billing, org policies, nothing else runs here
Preventive guardrails attached at the OU, not the account
Production e-commerce on AWS: multi-account landing zone (AWS Control Tower + Organizations)
Every account ships CloudTrail, Config history,
VPC flow logs, WAF and ALB logs here
Delegated admin for GuardDuty, Security Hub,
workload accounts share in via OAM
SCP: deny regions other than us-east-1 and us-west-2 (global services exempt)
SCP: deny leaving the org, deleting CloudTrail, disabling GuardDuty or Config
SCP: deny any action by the root user; deny creating IAM users and access keys
SCP: deny ec2:RunInstances unless IMDSv2 is required
RCP: S3, KMS and Secrets Manager only reachable by principals in this org
RCP: deny requests that do not use TLS
Declarative policy: block public AMI and EBS snapshot sharing
Tag policy: CostCentre and Service tags required on every resource
Detective controls (Config rules, Security Hub standards) report drift. Preventive ones stop it happening.
